name: Che bap
summary: Chè bắp on the 16 Apr 2024 Da Nang page is a corn sweet soup the page says did not start in Hội An and is still treated as a Hội An plate. The corn is from Cẩm Nam. A bowl has rock sugar, the corn, and coconut milk.
origin: Served in Hội An, with corn from Cẩm Nam, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page. The page says the dish did not originate there.
texture: The page says Cẩm Nam corn is evenly yellow, soft, and chewy.
taste: The page names the light sweetness of rock sugar, the corn, and rich coconut milk.
howToEat: Order a bowl. The page does not describe a topping beyond the corn, the rock sugar, and the coconut milk.
The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 December 2025 article also names chè bắp beside chè đậu xanh and chè hạt sen, and says each bowl is fragrant with coconut milk.
where: Hội An, using corn from Cẩm Nam. The 16 Apr 2024 page does not name a shop. Check on arrival.
